title: Cut the Rope
shortDescription: Cut the Rope helps define a Nintendo 3DS family puzzle path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Brings a source-aware puzzle entry to the Nintendo 3DS family browsing route.
Keeps third-party commentary and scores out of the linked metadata path.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Documented for the Nintendo 3DS family puzzle discovery path using the documented Wikidata platform mapping; this remains a catalog entry with its source kept explicit.
